title: should import alerts into a chosen folder
verifies: importing an exported alerts JSON with a non-default folder selected creates the alert in that folder (and not in default)

title: should create a regular alert in a chosen folder
verifies: a regular alert created while scoped to a chosen folder lands there, not in default

title: should create an anomaly config in a chosen folder
verifies: an anomaly config created with a folder chosen in the inline picker is written to that folder via the ?folder= param

title: should default to the default folder when no folder is selected
verifies: creation with no folder picked falls back to the default folder
